race.description: Concrete Industry Supplies Country Boosted Hcp (C3)
race.comment: Tricky race. ATHENA'S TREASURE (7) returns from a let-up and there looks to be plenty of positives with the claim from the rails draw. Jumped in trip and grade with a battling eighth to Transcend over 1500m in a F&M BM78 at Rosehill. No excuses over her pet trip. ZUMBO (2) far from disgraced on resumption when eighth over this journey at Randwick in Highway company. Since fitted with a 1100m trial placing at Scone. Anywhere near her best can see her play a leading role. MEGA PIXEL (10) holding his form in much easier grade and has gone to a new level this prep. Made it the second win for the prep when he sat on the speed from the outside draw to get the job done over 1200m at Narromine. Keep safe. MANOORA (4) winning claims look to be dampened by the poor gate. Another in career best form and look for her late. The chances don't end there.
